statement: The five retained direct-wired input windows did not report 0x45, despite its descriptor declaration. This is bounded non-observation in operator notes, not proof of global absence, firmware-independent behavior or a contradiction of kernel/SDL source-only 0x45 format.

applicability.revision: operator notes: July–August 2026; hardware revision unrecorded
applicability.scope: Notes §5 and §8; no per-report 0x45 shape from these physical windows.
